question: 按用户累计下单次数将用户分为三档（1-3单、4-10单、11单及以上），各档分别有多少用户？
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN cnt <= 3 THEN '1-3单' WHEN cnt <= 10 THEN '4-10单' ELSE '11单及以上' END AS tier, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM (SELECT o.user_id AS uid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o GROUP BY o.user_id) AS u GROUP BY tier ORDER BY tier
pred_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN order_count BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '1-3单' WHEN order_count BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN '4-10单' ELSE '11单及以上' END AS order_range, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM (SELECT u.id, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY u.id) GROUP BY order_range
